quantile_weighting: Each tetra or wall triangle receives equal weight; volume/area weighted means separately reported.
geometry_missing_rule: Outside fixed points remain missing. Common-domain errors alone cannot pass the predeclared full-domain gate.
wall_patch_rule: Raw wall-triangle centroid inside frozen physical sphere; no WSS smoothing.
normal_caveat: W0 uses owned WALL face; other cells use nearest finite WALL triangle and can be ambiguous at edges/branches. Spherical regions include bulk. Large bulk u dot nearest-wall normal is not by itself a near-wall anomaly or a physical pass/fail rule.
